@contextmanager
    def _native_capture_lock(self):
        native_root = self.root.parent
        if not (native_root / "workspace.json").is_file():
            yield
            return
        # Original portable.backup holds this same workspace lock exclusively.
        # Keep database/WAL activity within its shared capture interval.
        with (native_root / ".workspace.lock").open("a+b") as lock:
            fcntl.flock(lock.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_SH)
            try:
                yield
            finally:
                fcntl.flock(lock.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_UN)
